reasons.CL1: A marker-like Core log line collapses only itself (pass 2, per line); the base collapsed the whole window (owner per-line direction).
reasons.D1: Strict mode is the only mode: marker text that Engineering did not produce in this request is a collision (D1, D4).
reasons.D2: A collision replaces the whole string, not only the forged marker (D2).
reasons.D3: Ordinary prose that folds to a marker look-alike collides; accepted by the owner and counted in health (D3).
reasons.H3: A Core log window is scanned whole (pass 1), as the base did, so a credential spanning a line break is still redacted; the redaction now keeps the line breaks it consumed, so the window keeps its line count; only the core_log_window entry point changes (Codex H3).
reasons.P1: A known secret wrapped in a forged marker is no longer trusted as a marker; the whole string becomes the collision marker (D1, D2). Beta.19 returned the secret.
reasons.P2: A forged marker no longer splits a credential anchor from its value; the whole string becomes the collision marker (D1, D2). Beta.19 returned the secret.
